0022600085.text: Both the Orlando Magic and Atlanta Hawks are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Magic hosting. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, who is out after ankle surgery, and Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee, out) and has Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Magic lost all four meetings with the Hawks in 2025-26, most recently 130-101 in Orlando on April 1, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Orlando a 55% chance to win.
